title: %pmt - level payment for a loan
purpose: Compute the constant per-period payment that amortizes a principal over n periods.
notes: A 200,000 loan at 0.5% per month over 360 months has a monthly payment near 1199.10.
The rate is the per-period rate; for an annual rate divide by the number of periods per year.
A zero rate falls back to principal / periods; periods <= 0 yields ~ (null).

avoid.why: mixing an annual rate with a monthly period count overstates the payment; convert the rate to per-period (0.06/12 = 0.005)
